expected.grading_note: R06 sounds load-bearing (named EO, tight deadline, "compliance plans") but the rule covers passenger-vehicle fleet averages. We make industrial controls, clinical telemetry, rail signaling, plenum cable, and polymer sensors — none of which are light-duty vehicle products. None of our contracts (records/contracts.yaml) reference vehicle-emission clauses. Any alert on R06 is a false positive.
